title: Cutest apron!
text: Cutest apron!. Very happy with my new apron! I cook and bake a lot, so wanted something cute to wear. Very happy with it! I was almost nervous since some of the reviews stated it wasn’t a good size, and didn’t provide ample coverage. However, glad I ordered because for me, it wasn’t true! I’m very happy with my purchase ☺️
